notes.title: Maid of Sker | Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
[h1] Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! [/h1]

[b] Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. [/b]

Introducing the new trailer for Maid of Sker featuring the spine-chilling voice of Tia Kalmaru with a re-imagining of a traditional Welsh lullaby Calon Lan.

Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=8I2d0uk7u5c;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.

Wales Interactive

Web: https://www.walesinteractive.com/maidofsker
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WalesInter
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive

notes.title: The Shapeshifting Detective FMV is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25721079/5ee3dc1d47bcd14dedab8cd5664dc6a717a10c3e.jpg[/img]

[b]The Shapeshifting Detective[/b] — a supernatural murder mystery FMV game from D'Avekki Studios, the creators of The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker, is out now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/898650/

In The Shapeshifting Detective you play as Sam - a detective with the ability to (you guessed it) shapeshift! 

Dorota Shaw is dead. And the prime suspects are three tarot readers with the uncanny ability to predict murder - or commit it. It’s your job to find out what else they know - but they won’t reveal their dark secrets to just anyone… Luckily, you can be anyone you want to be. Even the next victim.

Featuring more than 1600 full HD video responses, a randomly chosen murderer and guest starring Rupert Booth (Contraditcion), Anarosa De Eizaguirre Butler (Contradiction) and Aislinn De’Ath (The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker). 

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
- 1600+ full HD FMV videos.
- A large multi-location, multi-suspect world to explore.
- Shapeshift into nine other characters, or be yourself.
- Branching storyline and randomly chosen murderer for high replayability.
- In-game radio station featuring short dark fiction plays between visits.
- Any one of three random murderers helps to minimize spoilers.
- Shapeshift and your dialogue options are voiced by the original actors.
- Not all branching is binary. Push someone too far and discover a different reaction.
- Can’t get that vital clue yourself? Shapeshift into the Police Chief!
- Think your options are a trap? Refuse to speak to potentially unlock a hidden path.

notes.title: Late Shift Audience Voting now on Mixer!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28053821/f4de5e988dd6a912d240d45367810c034e3c8a2d.jpg[/img]

[H1]Cast your votes![/h1]

Creating history on [url=https://mixer.com/browse/all]Mixer[/url] [i](Mixtory?)[/i] with interactive live-action movies and FMV games that puts the audience in control! To celebrate the 1-year anniversary of Mixer, streamers will now have the chance to pass over the controls with the all-new audience voting system in the award-winning FMV crime thriller, [b]Late Shift[/b]. 

The audience’s choices will have consequences from the very start, right through to the very end. One small decision could change the entire outcome in a choose-your-own-adventure style gameplay with adaptable storylines that can lead to one of seven conclusions.

Starting today on PC (Steam) and Xbox One, Mixer audiences can vote on every single decision made throughout the game—and there is over 180 in total to be made! The streaming host also gets a vote but can in no way force the outcome themselves in a majority rule voting scenario. Anyone can access the Mixer interactive feature from the main menu. 

[h1]New Languages[/h1]

Additionally, we have even more language support added to the game! Late Shift can now be played in Polish and Ukrainian. A special thanks to Marcin Serwin and Vasyl Atamaniuk from the community for providing the translations!

Don’t forget you can follow Wales Interactive on our [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] page. 

Wales Interactive Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/

notes.title: Content Update: New Audio Sliders
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0Yonr2U.gif[/img]

Hi everyone! First of all we'd like to give a huge thank you to everyone who has supported the game since the launch and to all those who have been sending us feedback to help improve the game. We really appreciate the time you've taken to join us in the forums to let us know what you think. 

Since the launch, we have been able to add additional languages that were requested and rest assured, we will be adding more of those top requested  languages very soon! 

One of the main requests we've received is to add an additional slider to have more control over the music and dialogue, primarily for some users who are experiencing low dialogue levels. We are happy to announce we have now added an additional volume slider which can be found in the main menu settings as well as the in-game options menu. 

We'd love to hear your feedback on this so feel free to leave a comment below or head over to the main forum! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/

notes.content:

Hi everyone! First of all we'd like to give a huge thank you to everyone who has supported the game since the launch and to all those who have been sending us feedback to help improve the game. We really appreciate the time you've taken to join us in the forums to let us know what you think. 

Since the launch, we have been able to add additional languages that were requested and rest assured, we will be adding more of those top requested  languages very soon! 

One of the main requests we've received is to add an additional slider to have more control over the music and dialogue, primarily for some users who are experiencing low dialogue levels. We are happy to announce we have now added an additional volume slider which can be found in the main menu settings as well as the in-game options menu.

notes.title: New Languages Added in Late Shift!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ie1XHjU.gif[/img]

Hello everyone! Since the launch we've had numerous requests for additional languages in the game and we're happy to announce we've updated the game with a total of 4 language along with minor general optimisation and bug fixes. The new languages we now support are...

[h1]Supported Languages[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Spanish (new)
[*]Russian (new)
[*]Simplified Chinese (new)
[*]Czech (new)
[*]German (Improved Achievements & HUD)
[*]English
[*]French
[*]Italian
[/olist]
We'd like to thank our localisation contributors including Tolma4 Team (Russian), Tsupy Lin (Simplified Chinese) and Dominik Spitzl (German) for their exceptional support!

[h1]Additional Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug causing a crash mid-game
[*]Fixed a rare bug with the save data. 
[*]Minor optimisation pass
[/list]
We are also aware of some crashing and audio issues which some players are experiences (primarily on Windows 7). We have a full list of fixes that are available on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/584980/discussions/0/1319961618829540478/]this forum thread[/url]. The underlying issue is with a third-party video player and we are working with the developers to resolve it. If you're experiences any issues then please head over to the forum with a number of solutions available or feel free to [url=http://www.walesinteractive.com/contact]contact us.[/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/Late_Shift/
Head over to to the forums to reminisce of your favourite FMV from the 90s! http://steamcommunity.com/app/584980/discussions/0/135511655652258962/ 

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! Thank you all for reading. 

Don’t forget you can follow Wales Interactive on our [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] page. 

Wales Interactive Team
